text:
Priya Shah: Hi all 44b I received my monitor but the VESA plate was loose in the box and the screws are missing. Also trying to sign into redwood-sec but my SSO prompts keeps saying my password expired even though I reset it this morning. Any tips?
Ethan_IT: Welcome Priya! Sorry about the screws. Can you DM the order tracking number and post the monitor serial here? For the SSO, did you get a confirmation email after resetting? Sometimes the SSO cache takes a minute to propagate.
Priya Shah: Tracking: 1Z888ZZ12345678901. Monitor serial: RWD-MN-5Z99C. I did get the reset confirmation. When I try to join redwood-sec I get: "Authentication failed: credential_expired" and then an MFA prompt that times out.
logistics-bot: Delivery update: Exception - missing accessory (VESA screws). Escalating to warehouse.
Hannah (People Ops): Hi Priya 44b we'll get you set up. Ethan, can we include a spare VESA kit and a USB-C power brick in the replacement box? Priya, if you prefer pickup, we can route to the SF office.
Ethan_IT: Yup, we'll send a VESA kit + screws + spare bracket and a clamp mount option in case you want desk-clamp. For the SSO "credential_expired" error: 1) Open https://id.redwood.dev/reset and confirm you're fully signed out of other devices. 2) Clear browser cookies for redwood.dev, or try an incognito window. 3) If MFA times out, generate a one-time passcode from the Auth app and paste it quickly. If that fails, I'll force a session invalidation on your account.
Priya Shah: Tried incognito and pasted an OTP from the Auth app but still get the same "credential_expired" error. Screenshot attached: [img-link].
it-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0457 (priority: medium) assigned to it_support.
Ethan_IT: Thanks. I've escalated to Identity team and forced a session reset on your account. Try signing out of all devices at https://id.redwood.dev/sessions and then sign in again. If you see the MFA timeout, reply here and I'll generate a bypass code.
Priya Shah: Signed out of all sessions and re-signed in successfully! Wi-Fi and SSO both working now. :relieved: Any ETA on the VESA screws/kit?
logistics-bot: Replacement shipment created: RWD-REPL-45912. ETA 1 business day, expedited. Tracking: 1Z888ZZ12345678902.
Hannah (People Ops): Great! We'll drop by with a spare USB keyboard as well in case you want to swap. Welcome to the team, Priya! :tada:
Priya Shah: Amazing, thank you everyone for the quick help. Leaving the hardware ticket open until the kit arrives.
Ethan_IT: Closing the auth piece, leaving hardware open on INC-2026-0457. Ping me if the replacement doesn't arrive.
